name: Grade 8 IT Practice: May Week 10 - Homepage and Media
description: Practice words for Grade 8 first-trimester work.

words.definition: The main page of a website.
words.example: The homepage introduced the project and linked to the evidence.

words.definition: The name of a page or project.
words.example: The title told visitors the name of the campaign.
The purpose explained why the website was made.

words.definition: Short text that explains an image.
words.example: The caption explained what the screenshot showed.

words.definition: Images, video, sound, or other digital content.
words.example: The media section included an image and a short video.

words.definition: Moving images with or without sound.
words.example: The video showed the project steps in order.

words.definition: Making something usable by more people.
words.example: Alt text improved accessibility for the campaign image.
